name: Rubik's UK Championship FMC 2025
information:
## This is the FMC-Only competition of [Rubik's UK Championship 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RubiksUKChampionship2025)


#### As FMC is not being held at [Rubik's UK Championship 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RubiksUKChampionship2025), this is your chance to become the UK's Fewest Moves Champion! The podiummers will be crowned during the awards ceremony in Birmingham*

Please see all the tabs to see the locations and information of each venue.

*\* You do not need to attend UKC to become the UK FMC National Champion.*
